title: Bathroom Urgency Spike After Caffeine
dataSources: Allergy symptoms (`allergy:entry`), migraine records (`migraine:entry`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), and sleep-talking events (`sleeptalk:event`).
app: Symptom telemetry for allergy diaries, migraine aura tracking, bathroom frequency logging, and sleep-talking review sent to Splunk HEC via apps and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bathroom:visit
| search urgency_score=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(urgency_score) as avg_urgency_score count as visits by _time post_caffeine_window
| sort - _time
description: Tracks bathroom urgency after caffeine over time and breaks it out by post-caffeine flag.
value: A post-caffeine split helps show whether one routine habit is driving a disproportionate share of the disruption.
implementation: Send bathroom urgency after caffeine events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of bathroom urgency after caffeine by post-caffeine flag.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how bathroom urgency after caffeine changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
